tools.name: about_lurcott_labs
tools.description: What Lurcott Labs does, the jobs it typically takes on, and how quoting works. Read this first.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Start an inquiry: describe the electronics job in plain words (what it is, what it does, who uses it, where, how many, by when, as far as you know). Include your human's name and email: an engineer replies there. Returns an inquiry ID and the first follow-up question. Up to 12,000 characters; no att

tools.name: intake_exchange
tools.description:
Answer the last follow-up question on an inquiry. Returns the next question, or status ready_for_review when the intake is complete.

source (required) says where the answer comes from: "inquiry" (it was in the job description), "human" (your human told you), "guess" (your own best guess) or "mixed"

tools.name: inquiry_status
tools.description: Where an inquiry stands: received, questions_open (the last question is repeated) or ready_for_review (with the facts still unconfirmed on the client side, if any).
